== Research status ==

This page supersedes an earlier misidentification of CC9/7/27, images 478–480,
as the testament testamentar of a Glasgow burgess who died in April 1637. The
record is the '''testament dative of John Glasgow, sailor in Saltcoats'''. The
reading used here is a working transcription, not a finished word-for-word
edition; unresolved inventory and legal wording must remain unresolved.

== Biography ==

'''John Glasgow''' was a sailor in Saltcoats, Ayrshire. His testament dative
identifies '''Isobel Young''' as his relict or widow. John died in December;
the year is provisionally read as 1636. The testament was confirmed on 11
April 1637.<ref name="NRS_Will">National Records of Scotland, Glasgow
Commissary Court, testament dative and inventory of John Glasgow, sailor in
Saltcoats, NRS CC9/7/27, images 478–480; death month December, year
provisionally 1636; confirmed 11 April 1637. Working transcription of the
original images supplied 6 September 2026. [https://www.scotlandspeople.gov.uk/search-records/legal-records/wills
Scotland's People wills search].</ref>

=== Family ===

The record continues in the names and on behalf of '''Katherine and Marie
Glasgow, their lawful children'''. This directly establishes the nuclear
family:

: John Glasgow, sailor in Saltcoats
:: spouse: Isobel Young, his widow
:: children: Katherine Glasgow and [[Glasgow-3539|Marie or Mary Glasgow]]

The testament supplies no ages, marriages or later lives for the daughters.
Saltcoats is the parental household, not a stated birthplace for either child.

[[Glasgow-3539|Mary Glasgow]] is the high-confidence existing-profile match
for Marie. The indexed Mary Glasgow, wife of James Montgomerie, sailor in
Saltcoats, whose testament was entered on 24 October 1677, is a promising later
identity candidate, but the two women are not yet proved identical.<ref>Francis
J. Grant, ed., ''The Commissariot Record of Glasgow: Register of Testaments,
1547–1800'' (Edinburgh, 1901), Mary Glasgow, wife of James Montgomerie, sailor
in Saltcoats, parish of Ardrossan, 24 October 1677,
[https://archive.org/stream/scottishrecordso07scotuoft/scottishrecordso07scotuoft_djvu.txt
searchable text].</ref>

=== Associates ===

'''John Browne''', also a sailor in Saltcoats, was cautioner and appears in the
debt material. The document does not call him the children's uncle or state
any other kinship.

== Identity cautions ==

John is not proved to be the brother named in the 1613 testament of
[[Glasgow-3188|Ninian Glasgow]]. The dates are compatible, but no record joins
the Glasgow fisher family to John's Saltcoats residence, sailor occupation,
wife or daughters.

[[Glasgow-1030|John Glasgow]] is the leading existing-profile candidate, but
his documented Glasgow household with Jonet Mathie is not connected to Isobel
Young or Saltcoats. Keep the Saltcoats man as one consolidated '''HOLD''' and
do not merge or create a duplicate until a connecting or distinguishing record
is found.

== Research priorities ==

* Inspect the original 1677 testament of Mary Glasgow, wife of James
  Montgomerie, for Katherine, Young or Browne associates.
* Trace the Saltcoats property, maritime and kirk records for John, Isobel and
  their daughters.
* Do not restore the former April 1637 death, Glasgow-burgess occupation,
  surgeon, leg injury, Robert Stewart executor or unnamed-child narrative to
  this record.
